target: S3 increment 1 — contract drift checker: validate (live or fixture) service output against the S2 contracts, flag missing/renamed keys
findings_summary: The S2 contracts (FloodServiceOutput/BushfireServiceOutput/ShadowServiceOutput) tolerate missing keys (parse to None) so a service RENAME silently nulls the card. The drift check closes that: compare the real service output's keys to the contract's expected fields; a MISSING contract field = a rename/drop (the #589 bug, dangerous), an EXTRA key = a new service field (informational). Pure check_drift(contract_cls, raw) is unit-testable now; a live runner calls the real services for the demo addresses and exits non-zero on drift (runs where DB/network exist = Railway cron / local). Shadow output has no 'outputs' wrapper; flood/bushfire do. Nested (bushfire compliance, shadow scenarios) checked at top level for increment 1.
model_design: check_drift(contract_cls, raw)->{service,missing,extra,drift}; SERVICE_CONTRACTS registry maps service->(contract, outputs_subkey). Live runner imports run_flood/run_bushfire/run_shadow (only when invoked) so the pure function + tests don't need heavy deps.
